title: "Tiles Outside Texture" warning unclear when "Setup" tab is not active
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads)

### Issue description

There is a helpful warning message for when you have tiles that are outside of the actual texture:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/10c63e05-6a1b-419e-a8e4-2a264280ad37)

The problem with this, as can be seen in the above image, is that the "3 dots menu" it refers to is only visible when you're in the "Setup" tab:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ad43d128-32cb-492c-b6cb-fef27b4c39de)

This isn't much of an issue but it is confusing, I was searching around for a while until I realised that was a contextual menu bar and the options changed based on the tab selected to the left. 

### Steps to reproduce

- Add a TileMap node
- Create a TileSet for it
- Add a tile source in the "TileSet" window
- Create some tiles outside the image (resize the tiles or add large margins for example)
- Close and reload the project and the warning should appear in the TileSet menu bar as per screenshots

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[tilemap-warning.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19635402/tilemap-warning.zip)
